title: Add Pulse AI to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pulse AI](https://github.com/XNet-NGO/pulse-ai) to chat
- Pulse AI is a consumer AI assistant for Android that uses the Pollinations text API (gen.pollinations.ai/v1) for chat completions and the Pollinations image API (image.pollinations.ai) for on-demand i

Fixes #11263

gist.headline: Pulse joins the garden
gist.blurb: Pulse AI, an Android assistant powered by Pollinations chat and image APIs, has landed in the app garden. One more pocket-sized place for ideas to turn into words and pixels.
gist.summary: Added Pulse AI to the community app listings: an Android consumer assistant using gen.pollinations.ai/v1 for chat completions and image.pollinations.ai for on-demand image generation.
gist.impact: People can now discover Pulse AI as a Pollinations-powered Android app for chat and image generation from the same assistant.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a friendly Android-style mobile assistant guide in a cozy app garden, presenting a glowing phone that shows simple chat bubbles and a tiny generated landscape image. Add code-plants and pixel flowers to represent the two Pollinations APIs powering the app, with the eager CRT Monitor Robot peeking over the phone.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny Android-green gardener cap, proudly holding a glowing smartphone showing chat bubbles and a small generated landscape; a cute CRT monitor robot peeks beside her among code-plants and flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle pixel-font text: 'PULSE AI', nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
